content.short: Netzprints is a utility-focused NFT project on TON offering lifetime discounts on VPN services.
content.description: Netzprints is a unique NFT project built on the TON blockchain that prioritizes tangible utility for its holders. Each Netzprints NFT serves as a digital pass that grants the owner lifetime discounts and exclusive benefits on the NETZ.RUN decentralized VPN service. The project focuses on bridging digital collectibility with essential internet privacy tools, providing a clear value proposition for its community. Netzprints represents the growing trend of utility-centric NFTs on the TON network, where digital assets provide long-term access to valuable infrastructure and services.
